title: Quantization in 60 seconds
caption: Quantization in 60 seconds: how a big AI model gets small enough to run on a laptop or phone.

scenes.say: A model is billions of numbers called weights. Stored at full precision, they're too big for most laptops.

scenes.code:
16-bit: 0.03471
 8-bit: 0.0347
 4-bit: 0.03

16 → 4 bits = a quarter of the memory
scenes.say: Quantization stores each number with fewer bits. Rounded a little, but much smaller.

items.title: Smaller
items.say: Going from sixteen bits to four uses a quarter of the memory.

items.title: Faster
items.say: It's often faster, because there's less to move.

items.title: Slightly worse
items.say: And usually only a little less accurate.

scenes.say: That's quantization. Round the numbers, keep the smarts.
